mission_03: Well done! You have created four custom transformers that integrate seamlessly with sklearn pipelines. FeatureSelector extracts specific columns, LogTransformer applies non-linear transformations, BinningTransformer discretizes continuous features, and InteractionFeatures creates multiplicative feature combinations. By inheriting from BaseEstimator and TransformerMixin, each transformer is compatible with all sklearn tools including pipelines, grid search, and cross-validation. The fit/transform pattern ensures that any learned parameters (like bin edges) are computed during fitting and applied consistently during transformation. Custom transformers are the key to making sklearn pipelines truly powerful, allowing you to encapsulate domain-specific logic in reusable, testable components that work with the entire sklearn ecosystem.
